summary: Full e2e testing of AI Incident Analyzer (backend + frontend). Created pytest regression suite (51 tests) covering health, auth/session, RBAC on all 9 admin routes (401 + 403), demo incident list/search/pagination, incident detail (work_notes suppression), real AI analysis via Emergent LLM key, analysis history scoping, ServiceNow + AI config (masking/persistence/test endpoints), audit-log secret leakage, and CRUD lifecycle (create->list->update->delete with persistence verification) for applications/kb/rca/historical. Found and fixed 1 CRITICAL backend bug (500 on all 4 admin POST create endpoints due to ObjectId injection). After fix: 51/51 backend tests pass. Frontend: login page, admin + end_user shells, all 11 authenticated pages, incident table (8 rows), search, P1-P4 filters, incident detail, AI analyze (5 sections + confidence badge), SN/AI test-connection buttons, full CRUD via UI modals (applications + KB), client-side RBAC redirects, and logout all verified working with zero console errors.

minor.issue: Update on a non-existent id returns 200 with the echoed body even though upsert=False means nothing was written. Should return 404 when matched_count == 0 (misleading success for the UI).

Client-supplied `id`/`created_at` in the body are accepted and overwrite stored values (id is forced back, but created_at can be rewritten by a caller). Consider ignoring immutable fields server-side.
@app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated in current FastAPI; migrate to the lifespan context manager.

issues: Priority badge '3 - Moderate' wraps to two lines and the text sits on/over the badge's rounded border, looking clipped. Add whitespace-nowrap (or widen the Priority column) to the badge.
During the 'Test AI Connection' request the spinner is rendered on top of the button label, making the text illegible for several seconds. Replace label with 'Testing…' while loading.
Delete uses native window.confirm() instead of the shadcn AlertDialog used elsewhere - inconsistent with the app's dark design system.

action_items: Return 404 from admin CRUD PUT when the id does not exist (currently silently returns 200 with no write).
Fix '3 - Moderate' priority badge text overflow in the incidents table.
Show 'Testing…' label instead of overlaying the spinner on the AI test button text.
Optional: replace window.confirm delete with shadcn AlertDialog; migrate FastAPI on_event to lifespan.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED BY TESTER: `_crud_routes._create` did `await db[collection].insert_one(doc)` then `return doc`. Motor mutates the passed dict by injecting the ObjectId `_id`, so FastAPI serialization raised ValueError('ObjectId object is not iterable') -> HTTP 500 for POST /api/admin/applications|kb|rca|historical. Changed to insert_one({**doc}). Apply the same copy-on-insert pattern to any future insert (db.analyses.insert_one(record.model_dump()) is already safe since the dict is not reused).
Same class of bug caused data pollution: the failed inserts DID persist, so 4 orphan TEST_ documents were created before the fix. Cleaned up via /app/backend/tests/cleanup_test_data.py.
server.py is 659 lines and growing - close to the 700-line threshold; consider splitting routers (auth, incidents, ai, admin_crud) before adding features.
Admin CRUD list endpoints use .sort('created_at', -1) but HistoricalIncident has no created_at field, so historical ordering is effectively undefined - add created_at to the model.
The end-user analyze prompt/response path has no rate limiting; each POST /incidents/{id}/analyze triggers a paid LLM call with no per-user throttle.
seed_data_creation: No permanent seed data added. TEST_ prefixed records were created and deleted per test; orphans from the pre-fix 500 were purged with cleanup_test_data.py. The frontend logout test deleted the pre-seeded end-user session, which was re-created with /app/backend/tests/seed_test_sessions.py (both admin and end-user tokens are valid again, 30-day expiry).
test_credentials: Bearer/cookie session_token: test_session_admin_001 (admin@test.local), test_session_end_001 (user@test.local) - both re-seeded and valid.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `python /app/backend/tests/seed_test_sessions.py` first if any prior run exercised the UI logout flow (logout deletes the seeded session token, making every subsequent auth test 401). Suite runs with `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -q` (pytest.ini pins -n 2 --dist loadscope). Backend expects ServiceNow to remain unconfigured (instance_url='') so the 8-record demo dataset and the SN 'not configured' assertions hold; TestServiceNowConfig restores the original config after mutating it. Analyze tests hit the real Emergent LLM key (~5-15s each). Run cleanup_test_data.py after failures to remove TEST_ orphans. Not covered: real ServiceNow instance integration (no credentials), OAuth /api/auth/session happy path (external Emergent endpoint), pagination Next/Prev buttons on the incidents UI (only 1 page exists in demo mode), and non-openai AI providers (anthropic/gemini).
rca_of_the_issue: All four admin CRUD create endpoints returned HTTP 500. Root cause: pymongo/motor's insert_one mutates the input dict in place, adding the generated `_id` ObjectId; the handler then returned that same dict, and FastAPI's jsonable_encoder cannot encode ObjectId -> ValueError -> 500. Repro: POST /api/admin/applications {'name':'x'} with an admin token. Mitigation applied: pass a shallow copy to insert_one so the returned document never carries `_id`. Verified with create->list->update->delete persistence tests for all four resources and via the UI CRUD modal.
